reason: In packages/core/EventManager.ts:118-119, the patch replaces optional chaining (`evt.destinationCalendar?.integration`) with `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` followed by an unguarded `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"`. Because callers such as packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1063-1067 and confirm.handler.ts:175-179 set `destinationCalendar` to `null` or `[]` when no calendar is configured, `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined` and throws a TypeError when `evt.location === MeetLocationType` instead of falling back to Daily.
